parameters.query:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT id FROM tickets WHERE jira_ticket_id = '{{ $('Extract Jira Fields').item.json.issueKey }}' LIMIT 1
)
INSERT INTO test_cases (ticket_id, jira_ticket_id, phase, tc_index, subtask_key, title, steps, expected, status)
SELECT
  (SELECT id FROM t),
  r.jira_ticket_id, 'qa', r.tc_index, r.subtask_key, r.title, r.steps::jsonb, r.expected, 'pending'
FROM jsonb_to_recordset('{{ JSON.stringify($json.rowsToInsert).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb)
  AS r(jira_ticket_id text, tc_index int, subtask_key text, title text, steps text, expected text)
ON CONFLICT (jira_ticket_id, phase, tc_index)
DO UPDATE SET
  subtask_key = EXCLUDED.subtask_key,
  title = EXCLUDED.title, steps = EXCLUDED.steps, expected = EXCLUDED.expected,
  status = 'pending', updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id, tc_index, subtask_key;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS testcase_threads (
  slack_channel_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  slack_thread_ts  TEXT NOT NULL,
  jira_ticket_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
  phase            VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'qa',
  created_at       TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at       TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  PRIMARY KEY (slack_channel_id, slack_thread_ts)
);

INSERT INTO tickets (jira_ticket_id, slack_channel_id, slack_thread_ts, status)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Extract Jira Fields').item.json.issueKey }}',
  '{{ $json.channel || $json.message?.channel }}',
  '{{ $json.message?.ts || $json.ts }}',
  '{{ ($('Extract Jira Fields').item.json.status || 'open').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
)
ON CONFLICT (jira_ticket_id)
DO UPDATE SET
  slack_channel_id = EXCLUDED.slack_channel_id,
  slack_thread_ts  = EXCLUDED.slack_thread_ts;

INSERT INTO testcase_threads (slack_channel_id, slack_thread_ts, jira_ticket_id, phase)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.channel || $json.message?.channel }}',
  '{{ $json.message?.ts || $json.ts }}',
  '{{ $('Extract Jira Fields').item.json.issueKey }}',
  'qa'
)
ON CONFLICT (slack_channel_id, slack_thread_ts)
DO UPDATE SET
  jira_ticket_id = EXCLUDED.jira_ticket_id,
  phase = EXCLUDED.phase,
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING jira_ticket_id, phase;

SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS tc_count
FROM test_cases
WHERE jira_ticket_id = '{{ $('Extract Jira Fields').item.json.issueKey }}'
  AND phase = 'qa';
